description: Reads two signals as the horizontal and vertical parts of a point and rotates that point about the origin, by a fixed angle, by a continuous spin, or by both, with offsets applied before and after

params.text: Sets the rotation angle, -180 to 180 degrees
Attenuates and inverts the rotation CV, and at the full setting 5V there turns the pair by a further 180 degrees
Sets the speed of a continuous rotation added to the angle, -3 to 3: in L mode up to 90 turns per second either way, and in H mode 261.63 turns per second at the centre, doubling per unit
Attenuates and inverts the velocity CV, which is added to the velocity knob before the total is clamped to -3 to 3
Switches the velocity between L, a flat scale reaching 90 turns per second, and H, a volt per octave scale giving 261.63 turns per second at the centre of the velocity knob
Adds -10V to 10V to the first input before the rotation
Adds -10V to 10V to the second input before the rotation
Adds -10V to 10V to the first output after the rotation
Adds -10V to 10V to the second output after the rotation

inputs.text: Turns the pair away from the angle knob, 180 degrees for 5V at the full CV amount
Adds to the rotation velocity, scaled by the velocity CV amount
The horizontal part of the pair, and the number of channels here sets the polyphony of both outputs
The vertical part of the pair, read at the channel count of the other input

outputs.text: The horizontal part of the rotated pair, the cosine of the angle times the first input plus its sine times the second
The vertical part of the rotated pair, the cosine of the angle times the second input minus its sine times the first

notes: bypassing the module passes the first input straight to the first output and the second to the second
